title: Capsules Animated Sticky Cards
description: Scroll-driven deck of pinned full-screen cards where the first card grows from a small rounded capsule into a full-bleed image over 300vh (ScrollTrigger scrub via onUpdate, synced to Lenis), fading out a looping horizontal marquee as it expands. Each following card pins, scales/fades the previous one back, morphs its image border-radius and scale, and reveals SplitText title characters plus description with power4.out.

motion.motion_signature: pinned stacking cards, capsule expands, marquee loops — the intro card's .card-img morphs from a 0.5-scale 400px-radius capsule to full-bleed 25px radius over 300vh (inner img counter-scales 1.5->1.0, stroke marquee cross-fades out between progress 0 and 0.5), then each later card scales its wrapper 1->0.75 and fades 1->0 as the next rises, while the incoming image scales 2->1 and its container radius goes 150->25px. All of it is imperative gsap.set inside ScrollTrigger onUpdate; there is no scrub anywhere.
